questions.question: Where should the Alloy model of AX-1..AX-8 live?

options.label: sdd/formal/alloy/ (Recommended)
options.description: Sits beside sdd/formal/tla/ as a live formal layer. Costs a README update (layers table, a new 'Alloy' subsection, running instructions). The later Lean 4 artifacts would follow the same pattern.

options.label: sdd/research/store-model-alloy/
options.description: A research artifact attached to the accepted doc, like tla-poc/. No changes to the formal README. It would have to move if the axioms are promoted into a spec.

options.label: Inline in the research doc only
options.description: The .als source sits in the doc as an appendix and is run by hand. No new files beyond the doc, but nothing can re-run it mechanically.

questions.question: How should the Alloy analyzer be run?

options.label: Docker script, no CI (Recommended)
options.description: scripts/alloy_check.sh + alloy.Dockerfile, mirroring tlc_check.sh. The Alloy 6.2.0 dist jar comes from Maven Central with a pinned sha256. Reproducible locally. No CI job until a check proves its value (README authoring rule 3).

options.label: Docker script + informational CI
options.description: As above, plus an informational CI job on sdd/formal/alloy/ changes. Rule 3's 6-month revisit then applies and needs a backlog entry.

options.label: Local jar in ./tmp only
options.description: Download the jar to the git-ignored ./tmp and run it with the host's Java 25. Fastest, but not reproducible for anyone else, and nothing is committed except the .als.

questions.question: Which trace records this Alloy work?

options.label: New trace file (Recommended)
options.description: sdd/traces/bk-435-alloy-store-model.yml with id BK-435. _schema.yml allows one trace per PR with the same id (aggregators key on the filename). This branch would be its own PR.

options.label: Extend the existing trace
options.description: Add phases to bk-435-store-model-axioms.yml. That trace already shipped with the store-model-axioms PR, so it would then span two PRs.

questions.question: How should scripts/alloy_check.sh pick its runner once a native Alloy is set up?

options.label: Native first, Docker fallback (Recommended)
options.description: Uses `alloy` on PATH if present, otherwise the pinned Docker image. One command for maintainer, container and anyone with Docker. Differs from dafny_verify.sh, which always uses Docker.

options.label: Docker only, native documented
options.description: Mirrors Dafny exactly: the script stays Docker-only, and native use is a documented `alloy exec ...` command (like `dafny verify` in the README).

questions.question: Should I also install Alloy natively on this machine now?

options.label: Yes, user-local (Recommended)
options.description: Put the sha256-checked 6.2.0 jar in ~/.local/lib/alloy/ and an `alloy` wrapper in ~/.local/bin. No root needed, uses the host's Java 25. Then I run the model natively to prove the path works.

options.label: No, document only
options.description: Only the repo changes: a session-init auto-install for claude.ai/code containers, a Local toolchain row, and manual steps. You install it yourself.

questions.question: What should the next session take on, once you have pushed bk-435-alloy-store-model?

options.label: Lean 4 lemmas (Recommended)
options.description: Step 2 of the doc's § 10: prove L1 to L6 over the unrestricted universe on a new branch. It starts with placement (sdd/formal/lean/?) and toolchain (Lean via elan, with or without Mathlib, Docker-pinned like Alloy) decisions. L3 needs a string lemma: splitting a `/`-join of names from N returns the names. This is the largest step.

options.label: Verify § 9 sources first
options.description: Read the ZooKeeper guide, Alloy slides, Morgan-Sufrin (DOI) and SibylFS at the source, and make dated corrections to § 9 and § 11. Small and independent. It firms up the comparison before the axioms are proved or promoted.

options.label: Decide spec promotion
options.description: Settle BK-435's open decision now: whether AX-1 to AX-8 become a normative spec, and which one. That decides what Lean is traced to. It is a design discussion, not code, and the doc says to decide it once the axioms are proved.

options.label: Pause BK-435 here
options.description: Leave BK-435 [~] with the Alloy step done and the handover current, and move to another item (e.g. BK-434, which inherits the AX-7 vs StoreTree.dfy mismatch).
